name: max-circle
description: Refactor documentation page by page to the level of Circle's developer docs — a four-tier system mined from the Circle corpus: the page system (four page blueprints, heading grammar, five paragraph shapes), seven sentence habits including word economy, per-mode section choreography (guide contracts, step openers, outcome confirmations), and the Circle lexicon. Default mode rebuilds each page from its blueprint with the facts as the only contract; an opt-in pass mode polishes sentences without touching structure. Ships a verbatim pattern library.
